stations.title: Her old look-up
stations.text: Shows an old copy, or falls over.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: No way to the repair itself

captions: A customer rings Dorrit about ticket 3104, the pocket watch.
Her look-up shows an old copy of the repair, and stops when a ticket is missing.
You write functions that reach the repair on the bench, or say plainly there is none.
Now the call is logged on the pocket watch itself, on Kasimir's bench.
Dorrit reaches the real repairs. Next, repairs that outlive the code that made them.
